Hi VD, I was supposed to upload this chart in as it is related to a
homework i'm doing atm. I hope u dont mind i put a link on this post to
my homework as well. :)

Lesson for me: a FL (FTR after a break of a flag) that is supposed to
carry/maintain momentum in that TF, is now broken down, and when the
flag behind it FTR to is broken down, that FL may become a strong
bouncer. Cheers.
